request.spec:
A period can be soft-closed (a button beside close): its due-total and every person's figure for
it are fixed at that moment, but claims dated inside it can still be added, edited, opened, settled
and voided; a claim added while its period is soft-closed shows late-entry yes and writes
LATE_ENTRY, naming the claim, after its CLAIM_ADDED line. Show closed as soft for a soft-closed
period. A soft-closed period can be closed (fixing the figures afresh) or reopened by a steward;
closing writes PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED period=<name> total=<due-total> for a soft close.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A period can be soft-closed (a button beside close): its due-total and every person's figure for
it are fixed at that moment, but claims dated inside it can still be added, edited, opened, settled
and voided; a claim added while its period is soft-closed shows late-entry yes and writes
LATE_ENTRY, naming the claim, after its CLAIM_ADDED line. Show closed as soft for a soft-closed
period. A soft-closed period can be closed (fixing the figures afresh) or reopened by a steward;
closing writes PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED period=<name> total=<due-total> for a soft close.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Soft close is in, and all 4 tests in the acceptance spec pass when run with `bin/e2e`.

**How it behaves**
- **New "Soft close" button** on each period row, next to Close and Reopen. It uses the same permission as close (`perm-close`; by default clerks and stewards) and only works on an open period. It fixes the period's due-total and every person's figure for it, then writes `PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED period=<name> total=<due-total>`. The closed column shows `soft`.
- **Claims stay editable.** Claims dated in a soft-closed period can still be added, edited, opened, settled and voided.
- **Late entries.** A claim added while its period is soft-closed shows late-entry `yes` and writes a `LATE_ENTRY` line naming the claim, right after its `CLAIM_ADDED` line. This applies to all three ways of adding a claim: the claim form, quick add and paste. The flag stays on the claim after the period is closed or reopened.
- **Close** works on a soft-closed period: it fixes the figures again at that moment and writes `PERIOD_CLOSED` as usual.
- **Reopen** now works on soft-closed periods as well as closed ones; the reopen permission is unchanged.

**Things to know**
- The Soft close button shows on every period row, even ones already closed or soft-closed. The test clicks it on an already soft-closed period and expects a refusal, so it has to be clickable there. Pressing it on such a period shows the period's error message.
- Splitting a claim doesn't mark the new piece as a late entry. A split doesn't write `CLAIM_ADDED` either, so I didn't treat it as an added claim.
- The automatic close (when grace days are set) also closes soft-closed periods, not just open ones.

**What changed**
- Migration `V43__soft_close.sql` adds a soft-closed flag to periods and a late-entry flag to claims.
- New endpoint `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/periods/{name}/soft-close`, handled by `SoftClosePeriod`. `PeriodCloser` now does both the full close and the soft close.
- New small helper `LateEntry`, called from the three add-claim paths.
- In the front end, the period panel has the new button and the `soft` display, the period figures stay fixed while soft-closed, and the claim list has the new `claim-late-entry` field.
